rationale: Assessed 2026-08-01. The already-pushed material is machine paths and private project code names with no credentials, no customer data, and no quoted product content — it is loop forensics about little-loops' own FSM machinery. Two facts killed the rewrite: (1) the same project names are independently public in 27 tracked .issues/ files across 52 commits, so scrubbing 7 postmortems closes nothing; (2) the repo has 2 forks, and GitHub's fork network retains the old blobs by SHA after a force-push, so the rewrite would not remove the content while invalidating 5754 commits for every clone. Prevention beats an incomplete cure.
rule: Loop-run postmortems and private-codebase references are handled forward-only: quarantine in gitignored postmortems/, gate new occurrences with ll-verify-private-refs, and do NOT rewrite public git history.
alternatives_rejected: git filter-repo on the 7 postmortem paths + force-push (incomplete: names remain in .issues/, and forks retain blobs); full scrub of postmortems + 27 issue files + GitHub Support fork-network purge (rejected as disproportionate to names-only exposure)
